title: Annual CQI education for pharmacy personnel
rule_summary: A pharmacy's CQI program must provide ongoing education in continuous quality improvement to pharmacy personnel at least annually.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply cqi education requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Annual CQI education for pharmacy personnel

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing cqi education with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
